decisions.symbolsMode: searchSymbols runs SQL over brain_symbol JOIN brain_file — the indexed corpus, never a raw filesystem or git scan
decisions.contentMode: searchContent runs FTS5/LIKE over the indexed symbol corpus (name+qualified_name+docstring); the source header documents that this is NOT full-text file contents
decisions.symbolMode: findSymbol reads indexed AST records from the brain database
decisions.fileMode: requires a brain_file row; throws 'file is not indexed' when the row is absent — disk content is only read for indexed paths
decisions.freshness: every search engine calls checkResultsFreshness, which compares the stored SHA-256 file_hash against on-disk bytes; changed files are flagged stale, never fresh

limitations: The audit proves the index-backed claim statically (query shape) and dynamically (row-deletion probe); it does not re-verify analyzer symbol extraction (that is the M12 analyzer work).
